non_idle_rule: After every result or interruption, immediately analyze, log, and launch the next experiment. The watchdog recovers only declared queued workers. When the queue is empty, the primary Codex process must plan and enqueue the next experiments. Wait only for an active process, active Codex planning, or required external operation. Stop only on exact top-level STOP.
current_hypothesis: The 1,000-example SFT dose scored 0.914444 accuracy and 0.686113 macro F1 on the fixed clean preference holdout. Increasing to 2,000 examples lowered these metrics to 0.901111 and 0.676790. A 750-example SFT dose may retain the gain near 1,000 while reducing noise from the larger sample. Candidate selection uses clean preference and source-specific SFT validation only.
experiment_queue: Train Qwen2.5-1.5B SFT on the full train_pref partition, 500 explicit tool_call Glaive decisions, and 750 deterministic When2Call train_sft examples.
Record training metrics and separate preference, Glaive, and SFT clean validation before test evaluation.
Run one aggregate-only official test measurement after freezing the candidate.

next_hypothesis: Compare the 750-example SFT candidate to the 500-, 1,000-, and 2,000-example doses on the shared clean preference holdout. Test metrics remain aggregate reports and do not guide selection.
